title: Tale of the tape (type poster)
hook: NOT EVERY HOODIE IS WORTH WALKING OUT IN.
primary_text:
Not every hoodie is worth walking out in.
Tale of the tape: 350GSM fleece. Boxy, oversized. Mesh appliqué front and back. Embroidered both arms.
This one was made for it. $109.95.
headline: Main event: the Walkout Hoodie
